title: ThreatTierChanged
description: The Static's Threat Director moved one tier (CONTRACTS §6; THREAT-DIRECTOR §3, Q-TD-1; NX-155). Emitted in the decision window that changes it, never while paused. `cp_smoothed` is the EMA of coalition power at that window. `side` names the Director that moved (only the ENEMY's runs until NX-375). Public view: cp_smoothed omitted (proposed).

side.description: The side whose Director moved (only the ENEMY's runs until NX-375).

cp_smoothed.description: Smoothed coalition power at the decision window.
